label: Transcoder (non-JSON document encode/decode)
type: the SDK's pluggable serialization layer that converts an application object to/from bytes for storage - the default JsonTranscoder for JSON, with RawStringTranscoder/RawBinaryTranscoder/LegacyTranscoder etc. for non-JSON content types
note: Minted independently, for the identical mechanism, across concept-docs/documents.json, concept-docs/nonjson.json and howtos/transcoders-nonjson.json.
